content.short: Hanji is an onchain central limit order book exchange on Monad with zero maker fees.
content.description: Hanji Protocol is an on-chain order book exchange charging zero maker fees, built around a logarithmic matching engine that keeps gas costs low per order. Liquidity providers can deposit into single-token vaults for passive yield instead of supplying a pair. Other venues can source its liquidity by integrating against the deployed contracts.
content.meta: A fully onchain order book on Monad, practical because cancelling an order costs almost nothing.
